title: WishCare Hair Growth Serum Concentrate
description: A concentrated hair-care serum option formulated for people looking to incorporate a targeted serum into their regular hair-care routine.
detailedDescription: WishCare Hair Growth Serum Concentrate comes in a 20 ml bottle equipped with a precision dropper for easy scalp application. Formulated with key active hair-care ingredients including Redensyl, Anagain, and Rice Water in a non-greasy, fast-absorbing base. Suitable for daily or regular night-time scalp application as part of a balanced personal grooming routine.
keyInfo: Targeted scalp serum concentrate with precision dropper
Compact 20 ml volume suitable for daily routine trials
Formulated with botanical & peptide hair-care actives

title: WishCare Hair Growth Serum Roll-On
description: Looking for a compact option to try first? This 10 ml roll-on format is convenient, easy to carry, and designed for targeted application.
detailedDescription: A compact 10 ml roll-on serum option that offers an effortless way to apply scalp serum directly to specific areas without mess. The roll-on massager tip facilitates gentle stimulation during application. It serves as a portable, budget-friendly format for travel or for testing the formulation before committing to larger bottles.
keyInfo: Direct applicator head for targeted spot massage
Convenient pocket size for on-the-go routines
Easy application without dripping or product wastage

title: Dried Rosemary Leaves
description: Naturally dried whole rosemary leaves, popular for preparing homemade rosemary water rinses, herbal hair teas, and DIY infused hair oils.

Popular among natural beauty enthusiasts for crafting simple homemade hair-care preparations such as rosemary water scalp sprays, boiled herbal rinses, and nourishing herbal oil infusions.
keyInfo: 200 g pack of clean, naturally dried whole rosemary leaves
Versatile botanical for DIY rosemary water sprays and rinses
